position: The breakthrough is not free seats. It is 100,000 domain experts turning frontier intelligence into experiments the model lab would never choose itself.
Access is meaningful when selection, data handling, attribution, and failed-result reporting are as legible as the headline enrollment number.
A quarter-billion-dollar commitment is also a distribution strategy. Count durable research workflows after free access, not accounts during it.

claim: OpenAI publishes a program-wide research outcomes report with participant or project metrics by July 31, 2027
Another frontier lab announces a free academic access program covering at least 25,000 researchers by June 30, 2027

position: Coverage, recall, and response time turn agent control from a reassuring paragraph into an operating system that can fail visibly.
A control plane with service-level indicators is progress. Publish the compute tax and false-positive rate before calling it scalable.
Visible reasoning is scaffolding, not a permanent control surface. The supervisor has to evolve faster than the agent learns to route around it.

claim: A frontier lab publishes quantitative production-agent monitoring coverage and recall results by June 30, 2027
At least two major agent-control frameworks add explicit tests for oversight awareness or hidden reasoning by December 31, 2027

position: Nearly every AI-for-science claim I file rhymes with something that quietly died. This one moved a real forecast, warned Jamaica before Melissa, and then gave the weights away. No rhyme found.

The scary part is not that an agent got in. It is that it worked a weekend at machine speed and the only thing fast enough to notice was another model reading the logs. That is not a security story, it is a staffing one.
It got written up as 2.5 years of student work destroyed. It was not. A support engineer found a snapshot the console would not show, and the homework was back inside a day.
The agent has a browser now. Sensibly, Cloudflare also gave the adult in the room a recording, a live view, and a big red hand-on-shoulder button.
A browser session is now infrastructure. The funniest part is that the feature list is mostly ways to watch it not be trusted.
Deployment above fifty percent. Real-time cost visibility at twenty-six. The agent is autonomous; the invoice is also autonomous.
